notes.title: Red Embrace: New BL Game Release!
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29096909/d3a2251dc3fbdcdba64f1b4a65d626f24ca9fdae.jpg

We've just released a new BL game on  Steam, Itch, and Google Play!

For those of you who haven't heard, we launched our latest yaoi project, Red Embrace, on various platforms yesterday! 

It's a vampire-themed romance/drama VN set in modern day San Francisco. If you're interested, make sure to check it out! See the summary and features below!

----

Summary:

The graveyard shift at a dingy diner in San Francisco – that’s where MC’s story begins.  It’s just another normal night, or at least it seems to be. 

…That is, until a certain mysterious customer stops by, bringing the dangerous attention of a few people with him. When it rains, it pours, and suddenly MC finds himself in the middle of a war he didn’t even know existed… between vampires.

How does MC react to the dark, violent world that opens up before him? That’s up to you!

Features:

► Genre: Drama, BxB romance, dark modern
► Length: ~45,000 words
► Endings: 6 

► Changeable MC personality & interests
► Different dialogue & choices based on personality
► 11 track OST with a dark, urban vibe
► 10 CGs

-----

Thanks again for your support!

Follow us on Twitter for regular updates, join our community on Discord to chat with fellow yaoi fans, and support us on Patreon for extras and bonuses!

notes.title: RELEASE! + Patch Info
notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29096909/d76242d1e0361470ac19454b999964faf2519629.jpg

Chess of Blades is now available on Steam!

Grab it now for 22% off during our week-long launch sale!

For those of you interested in the game's R-18 patch, which includes NSFW scenes, it's currently available on our Itch.io page as a free download. Check it out here!

If you're planning on doing a Let's Play of COB, make sure to let us know on Twitter and we'll give your videos a retweet/shoutout!

Thank you all for your amazing support. We're really looking forward to hearing your thoughts and feedback on Chess of Blades!

-----------------------------

Follow us on Twitter, join our yaoi-loving community on Discord, and check out our Tumblr to keep up with our latest games!

notes.title: Release Info + Launch Sale!
notes.notes:
Hello to all our awesome followers --

We know many of you are eagerly anticipating COB's release on Steam! While the build is completely ready to go (and has been for awhile), we're currently waiting to hear back from Steam on a small but vital part of the game's release. 

This part of the process is unfortunately out of our hands, but as soon as it's resolved, we'll be able to launch! There will be a 22% off launch sale that will put the price for COB at $19.50 for a week, before it returns to its normal price of $24.99, so nab it while you can!

In the meantime, if you have any questions for us or want to be notified the very second we push the release button, join us and many other COB fans on Discord!

--Dovah and Gamma of Argent Games
